agents.name: Cognition
agents.description: Routes each message to the right agent: idea and template questions to the Cognition Assistant (idea-planner), research analysis, evidence discovery, blind spots and the business plan to the Research Agent. Slash commands of both work here.

commands.name: /idea
commands.description: Analyze an idea: which templates cover what, and what is missing

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: A question about the templates, the research or a previous answer

commands.name: /clarify
commands.description: Help me put into words what I want

commands.name: /analyze
commands.description: Extract cited facts from a Knowledge document

commands.name: /discover
commands.description: Find new evidence: market, competitors, ads, communities, reviews

commands.name: /gaps
commands.description: What are the blind spots and what to research next

commands.name: /legal
commands.description: Find what laws and regulators say about the product (official sources only, not legal advice)

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Write the business plan: a Lean Canvas and a financial model from accepted findings
